record.original_question: Let (wn) be a complex sequence such that the weighted averages (1/N) Σ_{n=1}^N wn ψ(n) converge for every generalized 2-step nilsequence ψ. Must it follow that for every system (X, X, µ, T, S) and f, g ∈ L∞(µ), the averages (1/N) Σ_{n=1}^N wn T^n f · S^n g converge weakly in L2(µ)?

evidence.quote: Variant of Special Case of Problem 3. Let (wn) be a sequence of complex numbers such that the averages 1/N Σ wn ψ(n) converge for every generalized 2-step nilsequence ψ. Show that for every system (X, X , µ, T, S) and functions f, g ∈ L∞(µ), the averages 1/N Σ wn T^n f · S^n g converge weakly in L2(µ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. A measure-preserving system is a quadruple $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu,T)$ where $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu)$ is a standard probability space and $T\colon X	o X$ is an invertible measurable transformation that preserves $\mu$. By a system $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu,T,S)$ we mean such a probability space equipped with two commuting invertible $\mu$-preserving transformations $T$ and $S$.

A $k$-step nilmanifold is a quotient $G/\Gamma$ where $G$ is a connected, simply connected $k$-step nilpotent Lie group and $\Gamma\subset G$ is a discrete cocompact subgroup. A basic $k$-step nilsequence is a sequence of the form $(F(a^n\cdot e\Gamma))_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$, where $a\in G$, $e\Gamma\in G/\Gamma$, and $F\colon G/\Gamma	o\mathbb{C}$ is continuous. A $k$-step nilsequence is a uniform limit of basic $k$-step nilsequences. A generalized $k$-step nilsequence is a sequence $\psi\colon\mathbb{N}	o\mathbb{C}$ that arises as a bounded measurable function of a $k$-step nilsequence (equivalently, $\psi(n)=	ilde F(a^n\cdot e\Gamma)$ for some bounded Borel function $	ilde F$ on a $k$-step nilmanifold $G/\Gamma$ and some $a\in G$).

Problem. Let $(w_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence of complex numbers with the property that the weighted averages
$$ rac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N} w_n\,\psi(n)$$
converge as $N	o\infty$ for every generalized $2$-step nilsequence $\psi$. Prove or disprove: for every system $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu,T,S)$ with two commuting measure-preserving transformations and for all $f,g\in L^\infty(\mu)$, the weighted ergodic averages
$$ rac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N} w_n\,(T^n f)\cdot(S^n g)$$
converge weakly in $L^2(\mu)$ as $N	o\infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work (notably Frantzikinakis, "Weighted multiple ergodic averages and correlation sequences", arXiv:1511.05945) characterizes good universal weights for multiple ergodic averages in terms of convergence against nilsequences, suggesting strong progress in this direction. However, I could not find an explicit verification that the specific 2-step variant for two commuting transformations $T,S$ has been settled in full generality, so the precise status remains unclear from the available search evidence.

status_evidence.title: Weighted multiple ergodic averages and correlation sequences
status_evidence.snippet: A bounded sequence is a good universal weight for mean convergence of weighted multiple ergodic averages if and only if the averages of this sequence times any nilsequence converge.
status_evidence.claim: Related results characterize good universal weights via convergence against nilsequences, indicating substantial progress on questions of this type.

status_evidence.title: Convergence of polynomial ergodic averages for commuting transformations
status_evidence.snippet: Convergence of multiple ergodic averages for commuting transformations.
status_evidence.claim: Convergence (unweighted) for commuting transformations is established, but the weighted 2-step variant for commuting T, S is not explicitly resolved in the search results.
